2026-05-22.catalyst: US-China trade normalization following the Trump-Xi summit (May 18) lifted sentiment across HK-listed manufacturers. Johnson Electric's EV drivetrain and motion systems exposure positions it as a direct beneficiary of resumed cross-border supply chain confidence and recovering automotive capex in China.
2026-05-22.group_summary: The Trump-Xi summit (May 18) delivered a broad US-China trade normalization package — $17B+ in annual agricultural purchases, 200 Boeing aircraft orders, and rare earth supply agreements — triggering a multi-day re-rating of HK-listed manufacturers, semiconductors, and materials names exposed to cross-border supply chains. Johnson Electric (179), Han's CNC (3200), SMIC (981), and Ximei Resources (9936) all rallied on reduced tariff risk and renewed expectations for China capex recovery.
